title: ENIAC Plays Battleship (DRAFT 4 for team review)
description:
We built a new game for the ENIAC touch kiosk at the Vintage Computer Federation museum: pick a ship, work out two numbers, and fire. It runs on a faithful SIMULATION of ENIAC (Brian Stuart's simulator), not the 1946 machine itself. This is draft 4, shared for team review.

Come play it: Vintage Computer Federation, InfoAge Science and History Museums, 2201 Marconi Rd, Wall NJ. Wed, Sat & Sun, 12 to 5.

The full story of ENIAC, and of the people who built and programmed it, is told at the museum. Come see it in person.
